app.name: JioHotstar
app.description: India's leading streaming platform for live sports, movies, TV shows, and exclusive Hotstar Specials.

verdict.one_liner: Extensive data collection for ads and sharing with partners, though some opt-out controls exist.
verdict.summary: JioHotstar collects detailed viewing behavior, device information, and location data to personalize content and advertisements. Data is shared with service providers, advertising partners, and group companies. Users have some controls for interest-based advertising and data deletion, but the default settings enable broad tracking.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The app collects extensive data for targeted advertising and shares it with numerous third parties. While some opt-out controls exist, the default settings enable broad tracking of your viewing habits and device activity. Consider if the content is worth the privacy trade-off.

red.title: Extensive behavioral tracking for targeted ads across devices
red.plain_english: The policy states they track everything you watch, when you watch it, your device info, and use advertising identifiers (IDFA, GAID) to show you personalized ads. This data is linked across all your devices and shared with advertising exchanges.

red.title: Data shared with advertising partners and group companies
red.plain_english: Your information is shared with service providers, business partners, advertising networks, analytics providers, and group companies for marketing and product improvement purposes.

red.title: Precise GPS location collected with permission
red.plain_english: With your permission, the app collects your exact GPS location to provide localized content and advertisements based on where you are.

red.title: Unique device identifiers used for tracking
red.plain_english: The policy states they collect device IDs, advertising identifiers (IDFA/GAID), and create unique customer identifiers to track your activity across devices and link your data.

red.title: IP address used to determine your location
red.plain_english: Your IP address is collected and used to determine your approximate location, even when you don't share precise GPS data.

red.title: Marketing data kept for maximum period allowed by law
red.plain_english: The policy explicitly states that data used for marketing and advertising is retained for the maximum period allowed by law in your territory, which could be years.

green.title: Users can opt out of interest-based advertising
green.plain_english: The policy states you can opt out of interest-based ads by configuring settings on your device under 'privacy' or 'ads'.

green.title: Account deletion and data erasure available
green.plain_english: Users can request erasure of personal information and close their account, though some data may be retained for legal and fraud prevention purposes.

green.title: Data access and portability rights provided
green.plain_english: In some jurisdictions, users can request copies of their personal information in a machine-readable format and request transmission to another service provider.

green.title: Kid's mode feature for child-friendly content
green.plain_english: The app includes a Kid's mode that provides access exclusively to children-friendly content when activated.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Camera and microphone are accessed only when you use features like uploading photos/videos or voice-enabled features.
categories.detail: The policy mentions accessing camera roll settings and voice-enabled features. Access is user-initiated and not continuous.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Collects both approximate location from IP/SIM and precise GPS location if you give permission, used for localized content and ads.
categories.detail: The policy states they collect general location from IP address and SIM card, and precise GPS location with explicit permission. Location is used to provide localized content and advertisements.
categories.policy_excerpt: general location, including location based on your mobile phone SIM card and/or IP address and, with your permission, your precise location based on GPS data
concerns: Precise GPS location collected
IP address used for location inference

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: May access your phone and social network contacts with your permission to help identify connections.
categories.detail: The policy states that with permission, they may collect information from your phone and social network contacts. This is optional and user-initiated.
categories.policy_excerpt: your phone and social network contacts, with your permission
concerns: Contacts uploaded to servers if permission granted

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Accesses your camera roll only when you choose to upload or share content.
categories.detail: The policy mentions camera roll settings, implying photos and videos may be accessed when you actively choose to share content. This is user-initiated.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Your data is shared with service providers, advertising partners, business partners, analytics providers, and group companies for marketing and product improvement.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states they share personal information with service providers, business or promotional partners, advertising/data exchanges, and group companies. Advertising identifiers are shared with exchanges to decide which ads you see.
categories.policy_excerpt: We or our service providers may also share your advertisement identifiers such as IDFA, GAID etc. with advertising / data exchanges
concerns: Data shared with advertising exchanges
Shared with business and promotional partners
Group companies can access your information
No opt-out from sharing with service providers

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Requires name, email, phone, age, gender to create account. Links with social media if you choose to login that way.
categories.detail: Account creation requires personal information including name, email, phone number, age, and gender. Users can also sign up/login using social media accounts like Facebook, which may share profile and friend information.
categories.policy_excerpt: Name, Email Address, Phone number, Age or date of birth, Gender... Allow you to Sign Up/ Log In using social media accounts like Facebook
concerns: Social login shares friend list and profile data
Unique customer ID links activity across devices

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Tracks everything you watch, your viewing time, search queries, and device activity to show personalized ads across all your devices.
categories.detail: The policy describes extensive tracking including pages viewed, watch times, content selection, watch history, search queries, transactions, device information, and advertising identifiers. This is used for 'interest-based advertising' across all your streaming devices.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your activity on the JioHotstar Service such as pages/titles viewed, load times, watch times, content selection and watch history... Display or target advertisements on the Platform based on your registration or profile information, location and/or your activity on the Platform across all your streaming devices
concerns: Comprehensive viewing history tracked
Activity linked across all devices
Search queries logged and used for ads
Device advertising identifiers used for tracking

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: States users must be 18+, but has a Kid's mode feature for child-friendly content when supervised by parents.
categories.detail: The policy states they do not knowingly permit anyone under 18 to register. However, the Platform includes a Kid's mode feature. Under-18s may use the service with parent/guardian involvement and approval.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not knowingly permit any person who is under 18 years of age to register... The Platform includes a Kid's mode feature
concerns: 18+ requirement but Kid's mode available
No robust age verification mechanism

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Logs your IP address continuously and uses it to determine your location and troubleshoot issues.
categories.detail: The policy states they collect information about the network you connect to, including your IP address. IP is used for location inference and to determine relevant services when traveling.
categories.policy_excerpt: Information about the network you connect your device to, including your IP address
concerns: IP address logged continuously
IP used for location inference

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Collects detailed device info including device ID, model, OS, carrier, screen resolution, and creates unique identifiers to track you across devices.
categories.detail: The policy collects device id, device model, platform, OS version, time zone, mobile carrier, screen resolution, and creates unique platform-generated identifiers. They also collect information about apps frequently used on your device.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device and software information such as device id, device model, platform, type of operating system, installed version, time zone setting, mobile carrier, screen resolution etc. and other unique identifiers
concerns: Unique device identifiers collected
Information about other apps on your device collected
Persistent tracking across devices

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Does not collect health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data collection is mentioned in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Payment data is handled by third-party processors. The app only sees first 6 and last 4 digits of your card for support purposes.
categories.detail: Full payment card details are never stored by JioHotstar. They use third-party payment processors. They can see first 6 and last 4 digits for support queries and analyzing popular card types.
categories.policy_excerpt: this payment information is never stored or processed by us... first 6 digits and last 4 digits of your credit/debit card
concerns: Card digits visible for support purposes
Expiry date used for renewal reminders

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request data deletion and account closure, but some data is kept for fraud prevention, legal obligations, and tax purposes.
categories.detail: Users can request erasure of personal information and close accounts. However, some information is retained for fraud detection, legal obligations, tax, and auditing purposes. Marketing data is retained for maximum period allowed by law.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may retain some of your Personal Information as necessary for our legitimate business interests, such as fraud detection and prevention... We may retain and use your Personal Information to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations
concerns: Some data retained for undefined legal purposes
Marketing data kept for maximum legal period
Fraud detection data may be kept indefinitely

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Policy changes are effective immediately and continued use means you accept them. Users are notified only if changes significantly affect rights.
categories.detail: The policy states that updated terms are effective immediately unless stated otherwise. Users will be notified of changes only if they significantly affect rights or as required by law. Continued use constitutes acceptance.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Updated Terms shall be effective immediately (unless we state otherwise)... We will notify you of any changes to this Privacy Notice if the changes significantly affect your rights or as may be required by law
concerns: Continued use = automatic acceptance
Only notified of significant changes
